headline: Flávio Bolsonaro enters US amid Brazilian criminal investigations
summary: Brazilian Senator Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Miami following his election defeat, prompting Argentine opposition lawmakers to demand clarity on whether he transited through Argentina despite a Brazilian court travel ban.
why: High-level political volatility and legal disputes involving Brazil's leadership disrupt policy predictability and sovereign governance ratings.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Political tensions and investigations surrounding defeated conservative leadership complicate legislative cohesion.
